title: How Does Face ID Work on Your Phone? 📱
description: Unlock your phone just by looking at it, even in total darkness. Discover the invisible tech mapping your face in milliseconds.

scenes.say: Your phone unlocks just by looking at it, even in total darkness and in a fraction of a second! So how does Face ID map your features with such precision?

scenes.caption: Invisible light beam
scenes.say: It starts with an invisible infrared flood illuminator that lights up your face, completely hidden from your eyes but instantly spotted by the sensor.

scenes.label: 3D mesh grid
scenes.say: A dot projector fires over thirty thousand invisible dots, mapping your facial contours in breathtaking three dimensional detail.
An infrared camera reads the dot distances, and an AI chip turns them into an encrypted mathematical code that cannot be faked.
That is why printed photos fail to fool the system, because the tech measures true depth instead of just flat colors.
Did you know? Machine learning algorithms gradually adapt to your changing features, like growing a beard or wearing glasses.
